title: Retain the stronger ordinary solution at its actual task
statement: For the concrete logical-damage source, two native syndrome measurements and a conditional Pauli recover the logical payload in one source call without a coherent history archive. The causal full-state retrieval certificates concern committed outputs at different deadlines and a different information objective, under a fixed known source with no source-changing feedback. Logical release still requires exclusion from later regeneration couplings and does not imply apparatus readiness.
